verdict.rationale: Buzz is a platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. A probe points to an official MCP server documented at docs/MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md, and Block ships buzz-dev-mcp, an MCP server that "gives any agent a shell and a file editor." However, the main documented way to connect an agent to Buzz is the ACP harness plus the Buzz CLI, not MCP, and nothing in the pack shows an MCP server exposing Buzz's own channels, messages or repos as tools. Missing for 10: documented content of an MCP server exposing Buzz workspace operations, setup/connection instructions for MCP clients, a tool inventory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
